posts.name: bolnerap
posts.cooked:
Termi-Nation Absolute Zero, Termi-Nation Bunker, and Termi-Nation Unity vs. Chokepoint in Ft. Adamant.

I Minted; it felt a little hairy at the beginning, but judicious application of a perpetually recycled Stealth Bot kept me from taking the worst blows. Once the board cleared up a bit and the game slowed down, I was able to get set up and did a pile of damage quickly, mostly from AZ and Unity. (Bunker's loaded-down Omni-Cannon sadly went toward knocking out Chokepoint's damage reduction. Ah well, should have been using it earlier.)  Final HP 11 / 15 / 12.

posts.name: Griff's Dad
posts.cooked:
I have never lost to Chokepoint. When I saw this set of heroes (some of my least favorite variants) and their opening hands (with practically no useful cards), I got worried. I got even more worried when the environment exploded with anti-hero cards and Chokepoint quickly beat all of my heroes down to less than 10hp.

But Unity finally got a modular workbench out and enough bots to start whomping. Chokepoint took our the enviroment herself. Absolute Zero drew the Impales and put them into play, shivering for more damage. Bunker kept accepting her shocking cards and then blowing up the equipment on his turn so they didn't do anything. 

I did make some misplays along the way. I didn't use beebot correctly, for example. But in the end, it was Mint. 6/2/2.

Finally lose to Chokepoint?

Not today, Chokepoint. Not today.

posts.name: starkenburg_alexander
posts.cooked:
Mint with 2/13/11. AZ was low because I just wanted to finish it rather than heal him back up from the Hoarfire.

Similar to bolnerap, redirecting the big hits to stealth bot, then cycling it back into play with Unity's base power saved quite a bit of damage. From there, I just plodded along as I could until I was at a point that I could start Shivering instead of just using Thermal Shockwave. The turn after I used Shivers, AZ went to town with a Hoarfire and blew up his Cryo-Chamber (nearly killing himself in the process) to do a pretty hefty chuck of Chokepoint to win the game.

Though the starting environment did have me worried, Chokepoint took it all out for me after a few rounds, which was nice of her ;)

~Komori

posts.name: The Grim Digger
posts.cooked: Mint at 0/2/3.  I have never managed to get the hang of Termi-Nation AZ, especially when he doesn't have external sources of heat or cold to trigger from, so he was most useful destroying ongoings with his incap ability.  Ironically, things really picked up when the remaining heroes were low enough to no longer have the highest health, so Chokepoint started attacking the bots instead.  That coincided with a run of platforms and Mr. Chomps, and it went pretty quickly from that point.
